notes: Steps: pick a weekend date with the agent once photos are live; arrange to be out of the house with pets and valuables secured; print or display a fact sheet; confirm how the agent collects visitor feedback and presents offers; set the offer review date.
prompt: I am Kevin Doud and my house will be listed for sale. Help me plan the first open house: how to choose the date and hours with my agent, a day-before and morning-of preparation checklist (cleaning, lighting, temperature, pets, valuables, documents to leave out), a one-page fact sheet template for visitors, what the agent should capture as feedback, and how an offer review deadline works in California. Draft a short message to my agent proposing the open house date and asking how offers and feedback will be reported to me the same day.
title: House: hold the open house showing (set the date with the agent, prepare the house, confirm how offers and feedback come back)
